errors.signOutFailed: Siyasobola kukuggya ku mukutu. Gezako nate.

Pwa.description: Kebera obubaka, links, ebifaananyi n'obutambi olabe oba mulimu obulimba nga tonnaabugabana.

Offline.title: Ekuumiddwa okukozesebwa nga teri ku mutimbagano
Offline.description: Alipoota ze wagguddewo gye buvuddeko zikuumibwa ku kyuma kino, osobola okuzisoma nga tolina kuyunga.
Offline.stillOffline: Tolina yintaneeti. Okukebera okwemulugunya okupya kyetaaga okubaako ennyunga, naye alipoota zo eziterekebwa wammanga zikyali zigule.
Offline.backOnline: Oli ku mutimbagano. Alipoota z'ogulawo zikuumibwa wano mu ngeri ey'otomaatiki.
Offline.savedDescription: Okutuuka ku 30 ku alipoota ze waggulawo gye buvuddeko.
Offline.emptyDescription: Ggula ekyuma ekebera amazima ng'oli ku mutimbagano era kijja kuba kikuumiddwa wano olw'okukozesebwa oluvannyuma.

Errors.title: Tetwasobodde kutikka olupapula luno
Errors.description: Kino kizibu ku ludda lwaffe, si ku lulwo. Gezaako nate mu kaseera akatono.
Errors.offlineDescription: Olupapula luno lwetaaga okuyunga. Alipoota z'oyiseeko gye buvuddeko awo zikyaliwo.
Errors.notFoundDescription: Akakubo kayinza okuba nga kamenyese, oba olupapula luyinza okuba nga lwakyusiddwa. Noonya mu tterekero ly'okukebera amazima, oba tandikira ku lupapula olusooka.
Errors.globalDescription: Waliwo ekintu ekyagenze obubi ng'osika app. Gezaako nate, era singa kiba nga kyeyongera okubaawo, komawo oluvannyuma lw'eddakiika ntono.

Developers.metaDescription: Waayo ebintu okukakasibwa era osome Zuula okukebera amazima okuva mu bintu byo eby'amawulire.

banner.description: Waayo ebintu by'oyagala okukakasa era osome ku kukebera amazima okuva mu bintu byo eby'amawulire.

preview.title: Okulaba, okusinziira ku nkyukakyuka okutuusa v1
preview.body: Kino kye kyokulabirako ekisooka ku API eri bannamawulire n'abakolagana. Tekinnaba kusobola kukozesebwa: enkola ey'emabega etandika mu mutendera 2, era ebikozesebwa, ebifo n'ebikomo biyinza okukyuka nga tennatuuka ku mulembe 1.

overview.title: Okutunuulira mu bufunze
overview.body: Zuula API awa bannamawulire abakakasiddwa n'ebitongole ebikwatagana okukakasa kwekumu okuwa amaanyi zuula.ug. Okukebera kukolebwa mu kiseera ekimu:
overview.step1: Sindika obubaka ku POST /v1/checks. Ofuna okugoberera ID amangu ddala.
overview.step3: Soma okusalawo, obukakafu bw'okubala, ennyinnyonnyola n'obujulizi okuva mu byavudde mu kunoonyereza.
overview.format: JSON ku HTTPS (UTF-8). Ebiseera bya ISO 8601 mu UTC.

auth.title: Okukakasa obutuufu
auth.body: Buli kye weetaaga kyetaaga API key mu Authorization header. Bannamawulire abakakasiddwa n'abakulembeze basobola okutondawo n'okuggyako keys mu Akawunti → API okufuna. Keys zitandika ne zl_live_ era ziragibwa omulundi gumu gwokka.

scopes.submit: Sindika obubaka, emikutu, ebitundu n'ebifaananyi okukakasa.
scopes.read: Soma ebiva mu kukebera era onoonyereze ku bintu ebyakakasibwa.

auth.serverOnly: Toteeka key API mu web page, app y'omutimbagano oba ekitereke ky'abantu bonna. Kuba API okuva ku server yo era oggyewo key yonna eyandiba nga yayitamu.

rate.title: Obukomo ku sipiidi
rate.body: Buli key esobola okukola {limit} okusaba buli ssaawa. Buli kuddamu kulaga obungi bw'ekirabo ky'olina. Bw'osukka ku kikomo, API ekyusa 429 Too Many Requests: linda okumala obutikitiki mu Retry-After nga tonaddamu.

headers.limit: Okusaba okukkirizibwa buli ssaawa ku kiyungo kino.
headers.reset: Bwe kiba nga okusasula kuddamu, ng'ekiseera ekya Unix mu sikonda.
headers.retryAfter: Ekitundu ekyo kyaweerezebwa n'okuddamu 429: obutikitiki okuwummulako nga tonaddamu.

submit.title: Waayo ceeke
submit.body: Sindika ekintu kimu okukakasa. Kozesa JSON ku bigambo, emikutu n'ebiwandiiko, ne multipart/form-data ku fayiro z'amawulire. Ekyokuddamu kijja amangu nga kirimu okulondoola ID; okukebera kennyini kutwala obutikitiki nga 10 ku bigambo era okutuuka ku ddakiika emu ku mawulire.

fields.content: Ebyawandiikibwa okukebera. Okutuuka ku {textMax} empandiika y'ebiwandiiko, {articleMax} ku kya katabo. Kyetaagisa ku biwandiiko n'ekitabo.
fields.url: Linki ya http oba https ejjuvu eri ku mawulire oba olupapula lw'omutimbagano. Kyetaagisa okukozesa mu url.
fields.file: Ekifaananyi, eddoboozi oba vidiyo, okutuuka ku {size}. JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, MP3, M4A, WAV, OGG, AAC, MP4, MOV, WebM oba 3GP. Kyetaagisa mu by'amawulire.
fields.headline: Omutwe gw'ekitundu ogw'okulondako, okutuuka ku bbaluwa {max}.

status.title: Funa ekivaamu
status.body: Kiddamu embeera ya check. Bwe kiba nti status eri completed, ekifo result kirimu ekintu kyonna eky'okukebera. Ebikozesebwa mu kulondoola byefaanana nga ZL-7K3P-Q9.

states.processing: Okukakasa kugenda kukolebwa okusinziira ku nsibuko ezitegeerekeka n'ebikozesebwa ebizuula AI.
states.failed: Okukebera tekwasobola kumalirizibwa. Ekifo ky'ensobi kinnyonnyola ensonga lwaki.

search.title: Noonya okukebera amazima
search.body: Noonya mu tterekero ly'ebitabo ebya gavumenti ebikwata ku kukebera amazima agamaze okukakasibwa. Ebivaamu byateekebwako olukalala nga bisinziira ku Community Confidence Score n'obuwereza, era ebisaliddwaawo ne bikuumibwa okuddamu okwekenneenyezebwa tebiriiko.

params.q: Ebigambo by'olina okunoonya mu mitwe, ebikunizo n'ebiwandiiko ebikebeddwa.
params.category: Okusunsula okusinziira ku mutwe, nga eby'obulamu oba okulonda.
params.language: Okusengejja okusinziira ku lulimi lw'ebintu ebikakasiddwa.
params.dates: Okukebera kwokka okukolebwa ku oba oluvannyuma, ne ku oba nga tekunnabaawo, ennaku zino (YYYY-MM-DD).
params.perPage: Ebyavaamu ku lupapula, okuva 1 okutuuka 50. Ekyokulabirako 20.

factCheck.title: Ekintu ekikebera amazima
factCheck.body: Okukebera okumaliriziddwa n'ebyavudde mu kunoonyereza birina enkula eno. Ebikunizo biyinza obutabaamu; ebitundu biyinza okwongerwako nga tebinnatuuka ku v1 naye tebiyinza kuggyibwawo.

fields.id: Ekya bulijjo ID eky'okukebera amazima agaafulumizibwa.
fields.trackingId: Okulondoola ID kwaddamu nga ebirimu byaweereddwayo.
fields.confidence: Zuula akakasa atya mu kusalawo, okuva ku 0 okutuuka ku 100.
fields.findings: Okwogera mu bumpimpi ku ekyo ekitali kituufu n'ekyo ekiri ekituufu.
fields.claims: Okwemulugunya okusangiddwa mu biwandiiko, n'ebifo by'ennukuta, okwekenneenya, ensonga n'obujulizi obukikakasa.
fields.citations: Ensibuko ezikozeseddwa, nga zirina erinnya, omutwe, akakwate, ennaku z'okuzifulumya n'ekifo: supports, contradicts oba context.
fields.aiSignals: Okukebera ku AI eby'okukola oba okukyusa ebirimu, buli kimu nga kirina obubonero, omuwendo n'enkola.
fields.community: Okubala okutuufu n'okutali kutuufu okuva mu bantu, bannamawulire n'abakugu.
fields.humanReview: Kubaawo nga omukugu akakasizza oba okuwakanya ensala, n'ensonga ze.

errors.title: Ensobi
errors.body: Ensobi zikozesa enkola eya bulijjo HTTP status codes ne JSON body n'ekyuma ekisomeka code n'omuntu asoma message.

codes.bad_request: Okusaba kwo tekukoleddwa bulungi oba waliwo ekifo ekyetaagisa ekibulamu.
codes.unauthorized: Ekisumuluzo API kibuze, tekikola oba kyaggyiddwako.
codes.forbidden: Ekisumuluzo tekirina kye kisobola kukola ku nkomerero eno.
codes.not_found: Tewali kukebera oba okukakasa ebintu ebyo ID.
codes.file_too_large: Ebyokukozesa mu mawulire binene okusinga 50 MB.
codes.invalid_content: Ebiri mu mawulire bitono nnyo, biwanvu nnyo oba si kya kikwatagana.
codes.rate_limited: Ekkalaamu ekozesezza ekiragiro kyayo eky'essaawa. Linda okuddamu oluvannyuma lw'obutikitiki.

Related.title: Okukebera okukwatagana
Related.description: Okukebera ebirala ku mutwe gwe gumu oba okwemulugunya.

headline.line2After: Kyo kye ki? Nnyinza okukuyamba ntya?

Home.subtitle: Koppa obubaka, akalulu oba teekako eby'amawulire. Zuula akulaga oba nga ddala kituufu, si kituufu oba AI-kyakolebwa — ne <scribble>akulaga ensibuko</scribble>.

About.metaDescription: Omulimu gwa Zuula, enkola, obwetwaze bw'abakulira n'ekyo FAQ.

banner.title: Ku bikwata ku
banner.description: Omulimu gwaffe, enkola yaffe n'obwetwaze bwaffe mu by'amawulire.

why.title: Ezimbiddwa ku ngeri amawulire gye gatambula mu Uganda.

sources.title: Ensibuko ez'obwesige
sources.body: Ebikwata ku nsonga zino byekenneenyezebwa okusinziira ku bitongole bya Uganda n'ebweru w'eggwanga awamu n'abakugu mu kukebera amazima.

ai.title: Okuzuula ebirimu AI
ai.body: Ebipande AI-ebiwandiiko ebikoleddwa, ebifaananyi eby'obulimba, amaloboozi agatondebwawo n'okukyusa vidiyo.

languages.title: Ennimi za Uganda
languages.body: Olungereza, Oluganda, Acholi, Runyankole ne Ateso.

mission.title: Uganda erabira mu bingi ebikwata ku by'obugagga buli lunaku. Zuula abikebera nga tonnaabigabana.
mission.body: Zuula (ekikolebwa Uganda Fact-Guard) kye kifo ekikola okukebera amazima nga kikozesebwa AI-assisted, kyazimbibwa ku ngeri amawulire gy’atuuka wano — ku WhatsApp, mu group chats ne ku social media, emirundi mingi nga gisukka ku ngeri yonna ey’okukakasa amawulire. Weereza ekigambibwa ofune ensala esinzidde ku bujulizi, si kya kulowooza kwokka.

methodology.title: Engeri gye tutuuka ku kusalawo
methodology.description: Buli kukebera kulina emitendera ena gye gugoberera, ka kube nga kukolebwa kompyuta oba nga kugenda eri omuntu akwekenneenya.

submit.title: Oweereza okusaba kwo
submit.body: Koppa ebigambo, ogabane akakubo oba oteekemu ebifaananyi (okutuuka ku 50 MB). Ofuna okugoberera ID era osobola okulondoola okwekenneenya mu budde.

check.title: Tukikebera
check.body: Okwemulugunya kuno kukakasiddwa okusinziira ku nsibuko za Uganda ez'obwesigwa n'ebyo ebiva mu mawanga amalala, era ne kukebererwa obutabaamu bigambo bya AI, ebyokukozesa obubi n'okukyusa amaloboozi oba vidiyo.

publish.title: Ekiragiro kifulumizibwa
publish.body: Olabira ddala ensalawo, obujulizi obugirina n'ensibuko ezikkiriziganya oba ezitakkiriziganya — si kya kuteekako bubeezi mannya.

review.title: Abantu n'abakugu baffe batunuulira ensonga
review.body: Abasomi bapima ensala. Abantu abangi bwe baba nga tebakkiriziganya, Omukugu akakasiddwa akebera omusango era asobola okugukakasa oba okuguggyako — olwo alipoota n’ewandiikibwako “Human Verified.”

independence.title: Amateeka ge tukwatako
independence.description: Okusalawo kwa Zuula tekutundibwa, era tekwakoma nga tewali ngeri ya kukusoomooza.

label.title: Tukola obubonero, tetusangula
label.body: Zuula teyaggyangako kya muntu yenna. Tuteekawo okusalawo okw'obwetwaze n'obujulizi obukwatagana nakyo.

rules.title: Buli kuteebereza kulina amateeka ge gamu
rules.body: Okubala okw'abantu, abamawulire n'abakugu kweyambisibwa mu kubala obwesige bw'abantu, nga kwesigama ku byafaayo — tewali kalulu ka muntu kakendeezebwa awatali nsonga.

accountable.title: Abanoonyereza bavunaanyizibwa
accountable.body: Okukyusa okw'ekikugu kwetaaga okuwandiika ensonga era ne kuteekebwa mu biwandiiko ebirondoolwa abakulira.

sources.title: Ensibuko ziragiddwa, tezikwekeddwa
sources.body: Buli alipoota eyogera ku bujulizi obw'ekenneenyezebwa, osobola okukakasa endowooza yaffe.

whatsapp.eyebrow: Kijja mu kiseera ekitali kya wala
whatsapp.title: Kebera okwemulugunya okuva mu WhatsApp
whatsapp.description: Tewali app, tewali data bundle ya browser — weereza obubaka ofune okusalawo mu kuteesa.
whatsapp.body: Bot ya WhatsApp ne Telegram etegekeddwa okukola mu kitundu kya platform ekya API, olwo osobole okutwala obubaka butereevu eri Zuula nga bw'oyinza okukikola eri mikwano gyo. Teyakakasiddwa nnyo — kati, kozesa <link>Kakasa</link> ku mutimbagano.

free.a: Okukebera okwemulugunya n'okusoma mu Library kya bwereere eri buli omu. Akawunti z'abamawulire n'abakugu zeetaaga okukakasibwa, kubanga zirina obuzito bungi mu bubonero bw'ekitundu era ziyinza okwekenneenya emisango egirambiddwa.

submit.a: Ebiwandiiko (nga WhatsApp okugenda mu maaso), akakubo, ekitundu ekijjuvu, oba emikutu — ebifaananyi, amaloboozi n'ebifaananyi bya vidiyo okutuuka ku 50 MB.

time.a: Okuwandiika kutera okutwala nga 10 obutikitiki. Eby'amawulire bisobola okutwala okutuuka ku ddakiika emu. Emisango egitwalibwa eri omukugu agikola giba n'ekiseera ekigereke eky'okugikolako.

disagree.q: Kiki kye nkola singa sikkiriziganya n'ekyava mu musango?
disagree.a: Kiteekako obubonero. Obubonero okuva mu bantu, bannamawulire n’abakugu bugattibwa mu Community Confidence Score. Singa obubonero bw’ekisembebwa bukka wansi nga buvaamu obubonero obumala, kiba kyategekebwa omukugu akirabe era akakase oba akifuule ekirala.

languages.a: Okukakasa kusobola okukolebwa mu Lungereza, Oluganda, Acholi, Runyankole ne Ateso. Enkola eno nayo eteekateeka okukyusa mu nnimi ezo; ekintu kyonna ekitali kikyusiddwa kirabika mu Lungereza.

data.a: Wansi w'etteeka lya Uganda erya Data Protection and Privacy Act, 2019. Laba <link>Enkola y'Obutereevu</link> yaffe.

who.q: Ani azimba era n'ateekamu ensimbi mu Zuula?
who.a: Zuula (“Uganda Fact-Guard”) yakolebwa Centre for Intelligent Technologies ku Victoria University Kampala ng’ekikozesebwa mu by’enjigiriza n’okukubiriza abantu. Ebisalibwawo bikolebwa nga tewali muntu yenna oba omusasuuzi amanyi.

contact.title: Tukwatagane
contact.description: Ebibuuzo ebikwata ku nsala, omukutu oba okukolera awamu.

general.title: Okubuuza okutwaliza awamu
general.body: Emikutu, okukolera awamu n'ebibuuzo bya pulatifoomu.

privacy.metaDescription: Engeri Zuula gy'ekungaanya, okukozesa n'okukuuma ebikwata ku ggwe.
privacy.title: Ebyama
privacy.description: Engeri gye tukungaanyaamu, gye tukozesaamu n'engeri gye tukuumamu ebikukwatako.

overview.title: Okutunuulira mu bufunze
overview.body: Enkola eno ennyonnyola kye Zuula ekikungaanya bw’oba okukebera okusaba, okunoonya mu Library oba okutandika akawunti, era n’engeri amawulire ago gye gakozesebwa ne bwe gakuumibwa wansi wa Etteeka ku Kukuumibwa kw'Obubaka n'Ebyama, 2019 ya Uganda. Ekozesa ku mukutu gwa Zuula, era nga gutandise, bots za WhatsApp ne Telegram n’abakolagana ba API.

items.account: Ebikwata ku akawunti — erinnya, e-mail oba ennamba y'essimu, n'omulimu (Owa lujjudde, Omunnamawulire, Omutendeke oba Omukulembeze).
items.submissions: Okuwaayo — ekiwandiiko, akakwate oba emikutu gy'ebifaananyi by'osaba Zuula okukebera, n'okulondoola ID kwe kiba kiweereddwa.
items.ratings: Okupima n'okulaga ebikoleddwa — ebisalibwawo by'oyisaamu ekitiibwa, okwogera kw'oleka, n'ebintu by'olaga nga byetaaga okukugirwa.
items.accreditation: Ebiwandiiko ebikakasa — ku pulogulaamu z'abannamawulire n'abakugu, ebikwata ku by'okwekenneenya.
items.device: Obubaka obukwata ku kyuma n'enkozesa yaakyo — empapula ezikyaliddwa, ekika ky'ekyuma ekirondoola n'ekifo kye mulimu, okukuuma obuweereza nga buli bulungi era nga bukola.

items.pipeline: Okukola okunoonyereza mu nkola yaffe ey'okuzuula n'okulaga embeera yaakyo n'ensala.
items.ccs: Okupima n'okugatta obululu bw'abantu mu kigero ky'obwesige bw'ekitundu.
items.accreditation: Okuddamu okwekenneenya abawandiisi n'abakugu, n'okuwandiika ebyasalibwawo mu kunoonyereza.
items.abuse: Okuzuula ebikolwa eby'okukwatagana oba okukyusa engeri gye balonzeemu n'okukuuma omukutu nga tegukozesebwa bubi.
items.accuracy: Okupima n'okwongera ku butuufu bw'ebisaliddwaawo mu kiseera.

aiSharing.body: Okukebera okusaba kuyinza okubaamu okutuma obubaka bwakyo, oba okuwandiika ebyogerwa mu ddoboozi oba mu vidiyo, eri enkola ezikozesebwa okuzuula ebizibu era, okufuna obujulizi, eri omuwaayo wa AI eyateekebwawo. Ebyamawulire by’oyingiza bisunsulwako ku malware nga tebinnatandika kukolebwako.
aiSharing.review: Kubanga abamu ku bano abawa obuweereza bayinza okukola data ebweru wa Uganda, tukyusa enkola eno ey’okutambuza data nga tugoberera Data Protection and Privacy Act, 2019 nga tennaba kukolebwa ebweru w’ekizimbe ekikozesebwa mu kugezesa. Ekitundu kino kijja kuteekebwako obulungi nga okunoonyereza kumalirizza.

dppa.title: Obuyinza bwo mu tteeka erikwata ku bukuumi bw'ebiwandiiko n'ebyama, 2019
dppa.intro: Ng'omuntu ow'enkomeredde wansi w'amateeka ga Uganda, olina eddembe lya:

items.access: Funa obubaka bwo ku lulwo kwe tulina.
items.correct: Okutereeza obubaka obukyamu oba obutali bwa kimalirizo.
items.delete: Okusaba okusangulwa kw'ebikwata ku akawunti yo, nga bwetukkiriza okubikuuma wansi.
items.object: Okugaana, oba okutusaba okukugira, enkola ezimu.
items.complain: Bw'oba ng'olowooza nti tukozesezza bubi ebikukwatako, wandiika okwemulugunya kwo mu kitongole ekirabirira eby'okukuuma obubaka bw'abantu (National Information Technology Authority-Uganda).

dppa.outro: Okukozesa eddembe lino lyonna, tuwandiikire ng'okozesa ebiwandiiko ebiri mu <contact>Okukwatagana n'okwetaaga ebikwata ku muntu</contact> wansi.

retention.title: Tugikuumira bbanga ki?
retention.body: Ebyasaliddwaamu n’obujulizi bwabyo bikola ku byafaayo eby’okukebera amazima era bikuumibwa obutaggwawo, nga bwe kiba ku byafaayo by’amawulire. Ebikwata ku akawunti bikuumibwa ng’akawunti yo ekyaaliwo era okumala ekiseera kitono oluvannyuma, okuyamba mu kukola okukebera n’okukakasa ebikwata ku nkola y’okwekenneenya. Obubaka obusunsuddwa obulimu malware bukwatibwa okutuusa lwe kyetaagisa okufulumya ebyasaliddwaamu.

cookies.title: Kuki n'okutereka mu kitundu
cookies.body: Tukozesa cookie ey'ekiseera okukuuma ng'oli mu kifo, n'okutereka okw'omu kitundu okujjukira ekifaananyi ky'olulimi lw'oyagala ku kyuma kino. Tetukozesa bintu bya bakolera abalala eby'okulanga.

children.title: Obukuumi bw'abaana
children.body: Zuula kigendereddwamu abakozesa abali wakati w'emyaka 18 n'okusingawo. Tetukuŋŋaanya bubaka bw'abantu ku baana, era tujja kusangula obubaka bwonna bwe tumanya.

changes.title: Enkyukakyuka mu nkola eno
changes.body: Tujja kuteekako ennaku ku ntikko y'olupapula luno buli lw'anaaba nga etteeka lino likyusiddwa, era tujja kuteekako ebikwata ku nkyukakyuka mu <home>omuko ogusooka</home> nga tebinnatandika kukola.

contact.title: Okukwatagana n'okwetaaga ebikwata ku muntu
contact.body: Email <email>privacy@zuula.ug</email> ku kibuuzo kyonna ekikwata ku nkola eno oba okukozesa eddembe lyo mu Data Protection and Privacy Act, 2019. Laba ne <terms>Ebiragiro by'okukozesa</terms>.

acceptance.title: Okukkiriza ebikwata ku mateeka gano
acceptance.body: Ng'okozesa Zuula — omukutu gwa yintaneeti, era mu biseera eby'omu maaso WhatsApp/Telegram bots ne banne API — okkiriza ebiragiro bino. Bw'oba nga tokkiriza, nkusaba oleme kukozesa buweereza buno.

service.title: Kiki Zuula ky'ekyo (era nga tekiri)
service.body: Zuula ekukebera ebiragiro, obukwatagana n’ebyamawulire nga ekozesa okuzuula okw’obutereevu era, singa ensonga etwalibwa waggulu, abantu abakakasiddwa bwe balaba. Ekisalibwako kye kiraga engeri gye tukkirizaamu obujulizi obuliwo mu kiseera we kyasindikibwa, era kisobola okukyuka singa obujulizi obulungi buvaayo. Zuula kye kikozesebwa okukebera amazima, si magezi ga mateeka, by’obulamu oba by’enfuna, era ekisalibwako tekisikiriza ku nsalawo yo.

items.roles: Buli omu asobola okwewandiisa ng'omuntu wa bulijjo. Okubeera munnamawulire oba omukugu kyetaaga okufuna olukusa.
items.accurate: Waayo obubaka obutuufu bw'oba ng'oyingira mu kibiina oba nga weewandiisa okufuna olukusa.
items.one: Buli muntu abeere n'akawunti emu, era ebyama byo obikuume nga bya kyama — ggwe avunaanyizibwa ku bikolebwa mu akawunti yo.
items.twoFactor: Okukakasa okw'emirundi ebiri kwetaagisa ku akawunti za Expert ne Admin.

submissions.title: Okuwaayo kwo
submissions.body: Olina okuba n'obuyinza okugabana kyonna ky'otwala okukebera. Tokkiriza kutwala bintu ebimenya amateeka, ebyonoona obukuumi bw'omuntu omulala, oba by'otalina lukusa kugabana.
submissions.publish: Ebyokutereka ebikozesebwa bisooka okukeberwa obulwadde nga tebinnakolebwako. Okuwaayo n'ekyavaamu Zuula kiyinza okuteekebwako mu byafaayo by'okukakasa eby'amazima, ng'omukutu gw'amawulire bwe gufulumya bye gwekebedde.

ratings.title: Okupima kw'abantu n'enneeyisa yaabwe
ratings.body: Kola ku by’okusalawo mu bwesigwa, nga weesigama ku bujulizi obulaga. Okukolagana oba okukyusa eby’okusalawo (nga ebibiina by’ebikadde bikolera wamu okusindika ekisaliddwa) kisobola okuleetera okusalawo kwabwe okugobererwa era n’ebikadde ebikwatibwako ne bisimbibwa. Osobola okutegeeza ku bintu oba okusalawo okulabika nga kwekyusiddwa okuva ku lupapula lw’ebyokutegeeza.

api.title: API n'okufuna okutuuka ku bakola pulogulaamu
api.body: Abawandiisi n'abakozesa akawunti basobola okusaba ebisumuluzo API okuva ku <keys>Akawunta → API Ebisumuluzo</keys>. Okufuna kwa Partner API kusaliddwa ku bungi bw'okukozesa (kati {limit} okusaba/essaawa) era ebisumuluzo bikwatagana n'akawunti yo — tobyawulamu. Laba <dev>Olupapula lw'abakola pulogulamu</dev> okumanya ebisingawo.

ip.title: Obwannannyini ku bintu eby'amagezi
ip.body: Erinnya Zuula, akabonero n’ekifo bya Centre for Intelligent Technologies, Victoria University Kampala. Oyinza okugabana, okukuba ekifaananyi n’okwogera ku nsalawo ya Zuula nga oyongerako erinnya n’akakadde akaddayo ku lipooti.

disclaimer.title: Obutuufu n'okukugira ku buvunaanyizibwa
disclaimer.body: Tukebera buli ky’okwogera mu bwesigwa era tukuba obujulizi obuli emabega wa buli kusalawo, naye tetukakasa nti ekisaliddwa tekirina nsobi. Okusinziira ku mateeka ga Uganda, Zuula ne Victoria University CIT teba na buvunaanyizibwa ku byasaliddwa nga basinzidde ku kusalawo.

termination.title: Okusibira n'okukomya
termination.body: Tuyinza okusazaamu oba okuggala akawunti olw'okukozesa bubi, okukyusa ebipimo, oba okumenya amateeka gano. Osobola okuggala akawunti yo ku ssaawa yonna okuva mu nteekateeka za Account settings.

law.title: Etteeka erifuga
law.body: Ebigambo bino bikulemberwa amateeka ga Uganda.

changes.title: Enkyukakyuka ku bigambo bino
changes.body: Tuyinza okukyusa mu mateeka gano nga pulatifoomu egenda mu maaso. Tujja kukyusa olunaku oluli waggulu bwe tukikola; okweyongera okukozesa Zuula oluvannyuma lw’okukyusa kitegeeza nti okkiriza amateeka agakyusiddwa.

contact.title: Okutuukirira
contact.body: Ebibuuzo ku bigambo bino? Email <email>hello@zuula.ug</email>. Laba ne <privacy>Enkola y'Obutereevu</privacy> yaffe.
